visual.general_description: Two-column figure of serial cervical and ocular vestibular evoked myogenic potential waveforms (Rt and Lt) at 2, 4 and 7 months.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (left column) and panel B (right column) each show three stacked rows labelled 2 months, 4 months and 7 months, with Rt and Lt traces and printed peak markers (P13/N23 in A, N1/P1 in B) on a grey gridded recorder display. No patient identifiers or dates are visible; only small channel tags and scale text are printed.

panels.general_description: cVEMP waveforms, Rt and Lt, at 2, 4 and 7 months.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A holds three stacked evoked-potential recordings labelled 2 months, 4 months and 7 months, each with a Rt trace above a Lt trace on a grey grid with dotted gridlines and a black strip with small channel tags at the left. Peak markers labelled P13 and N23 are printed on both the Rt and Lt traces in each of the three recordings. Small printed scale text beside the Rt trace reads 10ms and 20uV in the 2 months recording and 10ms and 50uV in the 4 months and 7 months recordings; 10ms is printed beside each Lt trace. The traces are irregular, slowly undulating waveforms that differ in shape between Rt and Lt and between recordings. A small downward triangle sits under the baseline of each recording.

visual.general_description: Two-panel figure of serial static posturography center-of-pressure plots (A) and Foulage stepping test plots (B) at 2, 4 and 7 months.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A shows eyes-open and eyes-closed posturography paths with and without rubber load; panel B shows stepping center-of-pressure paths and red and blue foot-landing dot distributions with eyes open and closed. Each panel is grouped under 2 months, 4 months and 7 months. No names or dates are legible; tiny unreadable text lines appear above some plots.

panels.general_description: Static posturography center-of-pressure paths, eyes open and closed with and without rubber load, at 2, 4 and 7 months.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A shows a 2-row by 6-column array of small square plots arranged in three groups headed 2 months, 4 months and 7 months, each group holding two columns titled Eyes open and Eyes closed. The top row is titled Eyes open and Eyes closed; the bottom row is titled Eyes open with rubber load and Eyes closed with rubber load. Each plot is a square grid with a bold central cross and blue scribbled center-of-pressure paths; axis text (front, back, left, right, cm) is printed in the first plot and very small elsewhere. In every group the scribbles in the rubber-load plots spread more widely and look denser than in the corresponding plots without load, and the Eyes closed with rubber load plots show the widest, densest tangles. No dates or names are visible.
